market_pulse.note: About $62,400 to $62,450 as of 4:14 p.m. ET Wednesday, down about 2.4%, after starting the day near $64,000 to $65,000; it hit a four-month low of $61,000 on Nov. 15 (CoinDesk; Fortune).
About $1,754 as of 4:14 p.m. ET, down about 2.4%, after trading near $1,800 in the morning (CoinDesk; Fortune).
About $2.27 trillion early Wednesday per CoinGecko data, down 0.1% over 24 hours, before the afternoon pullback in Bitcoin and Ether (CoinGabbar; CapitalStreetFX).
About 57% per CoinGecko-based figures early Wednesday, with Ether at about 9.7% (CoinGabbar; CapitalStreetFX).

themes.title: Crypto lags tech stocks
themes.summary: Bitcoin and Ether each fell about 2.4% by late afternoon while the Nasdaq finished higher (CoinDesk; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Fed minutes add little new
themes.summary: October minutes showed two of 12 voters wanted a hike; CoinDesk called them old news given recent hawkish Fed comments, with a December increase widely expected (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Short-term holders under water
themes.summary: CryptoQuant said short-term Bitcoin holders are about 20% below their cost basis, the widest gap since July, and flagged $62,000 to $65,000 as the nearest support (CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflows and extreme fear
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had $239.9 million of net outflows on Tuesday and Ether ETFs $29.1 million, while the Fear and Greed Index sat around 11 (CapitalStreetFX; CoinGabbar).

themes.title: Crypto treasury firms pare holdings
themes.summary: CoinShares sold all its treasury Ether and half its Solana to fund buybacks, and Strategy's STRC preferred fell to its lowest since August (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both down about 2.4% by late afternoon, with Bitcoin near $62,400 and Ether near $1,754 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: XRP briefly touched $1.00 and Solana traded near $75 early in the day; Litecoin was down about 2.3% by midday GMT (CapitalStreetFX; CoinDesk).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: DeFi market cap fell 3.1% to about $58.9 billion over 24 hours per CoinGecko data (CoinGabbar).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoin market cap rose 0.1% to about $283.2 billion per CoinGecko data (CoinGabbar).

watch_list.why: Bloomberg reported the IPO priced at $83 a share, above its expected range; crypto has been tracking tech sentiment (CoinDesk; Yahoo Finance).
CryptoQuant and CapitalStreetFX flagged about $62,000 as nearby support, close to Wednesday afternoon's price; the Nov. 15 low was $61,000 (CoinDesk; CapitalStreetFX).
CME FedWatch has shown about a 96% chance of a December rate increase, with Governor Waller calling for a half-point move (CoinDesk).
